ScrollView widget

Source: R/widget-scroll.R
ScrollView-class.Rd

A container whose content can be larger than the widget. See scroll_view().

Super class

Widget -> ScrollView

Public fields

focusable

Scroll views can take focus so they can be scrolled with the keyboard even without focusable children.

direction

"vertical", "horizontal" or "both".

scrollbars

Draw scroll bars when the content overflows?

Active bindings

offset_x, offset_y

Scroll offsets in cells (reactive).

viewport

The visible content rectangle (after the last layout).

virtual_size

Size of the scrollable content: c(width, height).

max_scroll

Largest offsets: c(x, y).

ScrollView$new()

Create a scroll view. See scroll_view().

Usage

ScrollView$new(
  ...,
  direction = "vertical",
  scrollbars = TRUE,
  focusable = TRUE,
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Child widgets.

direction

Scroll direction.

scrollbars

Show scroll bars?

focusable

Can the scroll view itself be focused?

id, classes, style, disabled

See Widget.

ScrollView$scroll_to()

Scroll to an absolute position (in cells). Positions are clamped to the scrollable range at the next layout.

Usage

ScrollView$scroll_to(x = NULL, y = NULL)

Arguments

x, y

New offsets; NULL keeps the current one.

ScrollView$scroll_by()

Scroll relative to the current position.

Usage

ScrollView$scroll_by(dx = 0L, dy = 0L)

Arguments

dx, dy

Cells to scroll (negative: up/left).

Scroll to the top (and left).

ScrollView$scroll_home()

ScrollView$scroll_end()

Scroll to the bottom.

ScrollView$scroll_end()

ScrollView$scroll_into_view()

Scroll so that a descendant is fully visible (as far as possible). Uses the last layout; the app re-lays out afterwards.

Usage

ScrollView$scroll_into_view(widget)

Arguments

widget

A descendant widget.

Returns

TRUE if the offsets changed.

ScrollView$on_mouse_scroll()

The mouse wheel scrolls by three lines. When the view cannot scroll further, the event bubbles to outer scroll views.

Usage

event

ScrollView$arrange_children()

Lay the children out in a virtual area, shifted by the scroll offsets; reserves space for scroll bars when needed.

Usage

ScrollView$arrange_children(children, inner, st)

Arguments

children

Visible children.

st

ScrollView$layout_descend()

Children entirely outside the viewport are not laid out in detail (unless a complete layout is needed, e.g. to scroll a focused widget into view).

Usage

ScrollView$layout_descend(rects)

Arguments

rects

Child rectangles.
